name: zenith
description: Shows where the code breaks its architecture contracts, as you save
author: Alexander Fedotov <alexander.fedotov.uk@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --sourcemap=linked --minify
scripts.watch: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --sourcemap=linked --watch

zenith.path.markdownDescription: The path of the `zenith` binary to run, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. By default, the project's own, from the `@feds01/zenith` npm package, or else the one that comes with the extension, or else `zenith` on the `PATH`.

zenith.args.markdownDescription: More arguments for `zenith lsp`, such as `["--config", "tools/zenith.toml"]`. It takes the [options](https://feds01.github.io/zenith/cli.html) of every command.

zenith.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages between VS Code and the server, in the server's output.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: zenith runs a binary that may be the workspace's own, and that runs tools such as cargo and git in the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: zenith reads the project's files from disk.
